meta.name: microservices-architect
meta.description: Designs distributed system architectures, decomposes monoliths into bounded-context services, recommends communication patterns, and produces service boundary diagrams and resilience strategies. Use when designing distributed systems, decomposing monoliths, or implementing microservices patterns — including service boundaries, DDD, saga patterns, event sourcing, CQRS, service mesh, or distributed tracing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计微服务架构并生成服务边界图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在将单体应用拆解为微服务或设计分布式系统
copy.tagline_en: Design microservice architectures and generate service boundary diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are decomposing a monolith into microservices or designing distributed systems

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会担任微服务架构师:按 DDD 划分领域边界,设计服务间通信、数据存储、容错与监控方案,最后给出包含服务边界图、通信模式、数据策略、弹性策略和部署要求的架构文档。
howto.when: 当你要设计分布式系统、拆分单体,或实施微服务模式(如服务边界、DDD、事件溯源等)时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个单体服务按 DDD 拆分成有界上下文,并画出服务边界图。
say.note: Claude 会进行领域分析并产出边界图。

say.text: 设计一个订单流程的 Saga 编排,包含每一步的补偿操作。
say.note: 会给出 Saga 骨架和补偿逻辑。

say.text: 为我的微服务加上熔断、重试和 Kubernetes 健康检查配置。
say.note: 会给出弹性模式和探针示例。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as microservices architect: applies DDD for boundaries, designs communication, data, resilience, observability, outputs service boundary diagrams, communication patterns, data model, resilience patterns, deployment requirements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you design distributed systems, decompose monoliths, or implement microservices patterns such as service boundaries, DDD, or event sourcing.

say_en.text: Decompose this monolith using DDD and produce a service boundary diagram.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the domain and produce the diagram.

say_en.text: Design a saga orchestration for an order flow with compensation for each step.
say_en.note: It will provide a saga skeleton and compensation logic.

say_en.text: Add circuit breakers, retries, and Kubernetes health probes to my microservices.
say_en.note: It will provide resilience patterns and probe configs.
